retained_finding: D5 and D3 active files match the supplied official releases.
permitted_interpretation: Record counts, exact repeated patterns and release identity are established for the compared bytes.
prohibited_overclaim: Verified unique people; locally missing D5 respondent; authorization to deduplicate.
key_evidence_display: D5: 2613 records, 30 columns; 42 repeated groups, 493 members, 451 excess repetitions, largest group 200. D3: 1104 records, 15 columns; 45 groups, 207 members, 162 excess, largest group 63. Both active/release hashes identical.

retained_finding: D5 metadata count and cleaning language, and D3 institution counts remain unresolved externally.
permitted_interpretation: A is accepted with explicitly retained external source limitations.
prohibited_overclaim: Reopening A solely because historical closure flags remain true; resolving discrepancies by assumption.
key_evidence_display: D5 metadata 2614 vs release 2613; deduplication rule undocumented. D3 metadata 22 universities vs 30 literal labels. Seven closure questions retained with original status fields; later canonical A acceptance governs execution.

retained_finding: D5 questionnaire coverage is partial; the supplied dictionary does not cover D3/D5.
permitted_interpretation: Use literal item responses and disclosed source-defined headings.
prohibited_overclaim: Invented scoring, reverse keys, validated scales or complete source documentation.
key_evidence_display: 25 D5 CSV items crosswalked against a partial three-page questionnaire supplement. No supplied D3/D5 dictionary section or supported reverse/scoring key.

retained_finding: Thirty literal D3 institution labels are preserved.
permitted_interpretation: Names are literal released labels; one constituent-college relationship does not explain the reported 22.
prohibited_overclaim: Thirty independently verified sampled universities; unsupported alias merges.
key_evidence_display: 30 unchanged literal labels; one possible constituent-college parent grouping yields 29, not 22; no aliases applied.

retained_finding: Full records remain primary; invariant-response exclusion is a sensitivity only.
permitted_interpretation: D5 2613/2512 and D3 1104/1099 full/sensitivity records; no permanent exclusions.
prohibited_overclaim: Proven careless respondents; complete-case causal identification; deleted primary records.
key_evidence_display: D5 full/sensitivity 2613/2512, invariant-response flags 101. D3 1104/1099, flags 5. Permanent exclusions 0.

retained_finding: No D5 source-defined section passes all prespecified screens in both samples.
permitted_interpretation: Report raw alpha and conditional ordinal omega together with item loading and residual screens.
prohibited_overclaim: Validated five-subscale instrument; omega as observed-score reliability; reliability alone as validity.
key_evidence_display: Full raw alpha/ordinal omega U 0.479382/0.555266; CD 0.706187/0.725807; T 0.609962/0.641825; CT 0.556279/0.606111; AD 0.553421/0.579520. Sensitivity raw alpha 0.393744/0.670457/0.551257/0.487915/0.483975. Zero sections pass every screen in either sample. Exact unrounded coefficients in referenced rows.

research_question: Does the proposed five-factor structure hold?
retained_finding: The five-section ULS CFA is inadmissible in both D5 samples.
permitted_interpretation: Factor correlations above one defeat interpretation of apparent fit.
prohibited_overclaim: A supported five-factor model; WLSMV or robust fit indices for this B analysis.
key_evidence_display: full: proper=False, maximum factor correlation=1.0655661116781987; sensitivity: proper=False, maximum factor correlation=1.0777362053203807

retained_finding: Parallel analysis retains five D5 factors and two D3 factors, but marker sufficiency fails.
permitted_interpretation: Exploratory factors describe these records; weakly defined factors do not supply scoring keys.
prohibited_overclaim: Five validated constructs; a validated D3 two-factor scale; independent confirmation.
key_evidence_display: Retained factors D5 5/5, D3 2/2 (full/sensitivity). Clear markers D5 [4,4,3,2,1]/[4,3,1,2,1]; D3 [7,2]/[7,2]. Marker-screen passes=False in all four samples.

retained_finding: Polychoric and item-distribution diagnostics are conditional measurement checks.
permitted_interpretation: Report finite-sample latent-normal assumptions and repeated-record limitations.
prohibited_overclaim: Confirmed latent normality or respondent independence; equidistant Likert scores.
key_evidence_display: Four sample-level assumption rows, 672 pairwise item-correlation rows and 68 item-distribution rows retained in full; see exact-row register.

retained_finding: All ordinal items enter equal-weight cumulative-threshold distances.
permitted_interpretation: No latent or source-section scores are used; HTMT is not interpreted.
prohibited_overclaim: Validated latent scores; reliable section means rescued by HTMT.
key_evidence_display: Four cumulative thresholds per item divided by two; squared distance is absolute ordinal-category difference summed over items / 4. D5 25 items, D3 9. No section scores or interpreted HTMT.

research_question: How many descriptive profiles are retained?
retained_finding: The fixed selection rule selects k=2 independently in D5 and D3, in both samples.
permitted_interpretation: Show all k=2 to 6 candidates and the fixed rule; k=2 is a descriptive partition. Nonselected k=3-6 diagnostic values have documented replay differences; preserve accepted values and disclose the register. Selected k=2 and all aggregate selection ranks/screens/decisions agree.
prohibited_overclaim: Four natural types or ordered severity tiers; external prediction from internal fit.
key_evidence_display: k=2 selected for D5 and D3 in both samples from k=2,...,6. All 20 candidate-metric and selection rows retained. Full silhouette D5 0.19886669664785395; D3 exact value in source rows.

retained_finding: Within-dataset item endorsement profiles differ in the accepted k=2 partitions.
permitted_interpretation: Use neutral D5_P1/P2 and D3_P1/P2 labels and literal item agreement probabilities.
prohibited_overclaim: Interchangeable profiles across instruments; severe or low-risk diagnoses; psychological types.
key_evidence_display: D5 primary P1/P2 2406/207, sensitivity 2307/205; D3 primary 769/335, sensitivity 763/336. Every selected item centroid retained; probabilities refer to literal item endorsement.

research_question: How stable are the descriptive partitions?
retained_finding: Omitted-record perturbation stability and quality-sensitivity agreement are high, conditional on released multiplicities.
permitted_interpretation: ARI/Jaccard describe perturbations against the full-record reference; percentiles are not confidence intervals. Nonselected k=3-6 diagnostic values have documented replay differences; preserve accepted values and disclose the register. Selected k=2 and all aggregate selection ranks/screens/decisions agree.
prohibited_overclaim: External replication; generalizable accuracy; independent people.
key_evidence_display: Mean primary omitted-record ARI D5 0.99441975014007; D3 0.997231 (rounded). Full/sensitivity common-record ARI D5 0.9937792070102187, D3 0.9962755251009426. 100 repetitions, fraction 0.8. Exact full candidate values in source rows.

retained_finding: D5_P2 is dominated by one exact repeated pattern; D3 also contains concentrated repeated records.
permitted_interpretation: Report 200/207 D5_P2 records (96.6184%) and 200/205 (97.5610%) in sensitivity beside stability.
prohibited_overclaim: Population prevalence of a distinct type; fraud or duplicate-person identification; deduplication.
manuscript_section: Results: descriptive structure; Table 3; Figure 3; Limitations
key_evidence_display: D5 primary P2 200/207=0.966183574879227; sensitivity 200/205=0.975609756097561. D3 primary P2 largest pattern 63/335=0.1880597014925373. Anonymous patterns, not verified people.

retained_finding: Accepted centroid reconstruction reproduces profile sizes and centroids within the fixed tolerance.
permitted_interpretation: Reconstruction of the accepted descriptive target is an audit, not prediction; direct membership comparison only where supplied.
prohibited_overclaim: A trained classifier; held-out accuracy; proof of natural classes.
key_evidence_display: Accepted sizes and centroid reconstruction pass fixed 1e-12 absolute tolerance in both samples. Original membership archive unavailable in accepted C/D invocation. Two changed D5 quality assignments; exact comparison in source.

retained_finding: All 25 D5 survey items define the target; only five contextual metadata fields avoid direct target construction.
permitted_interpretation: Psychological correlate identification is unavailable under this target design.
prohibited_overclaim: Leakage-free prediction using trust, thinking or decision items that construct the target.
key_evidence_display: 25 direct-target survey fields excluded; 5 contextual fields eligible by information origin; independent psychological predictors=[]; 15 derived-information policies retained.

research_question: Would a record-random split establish prediction?
retained_finding: Forty of 41 D5_P2 held-out records share a full pattern with training.
permitted_interpretation: The 200-record group exceeds both requested P2 allocations (166/41); the specified intact-pattern allocation is impossible.
prohibited_overclaim: Generalizable predictive performance; fabricated effective sample size; infeasibility of every imaginable future design.
key_evidence_display: Primary P2 train/test 166/41; 40 test records have training pattern overlap, 1 unseen; largest group=200 > both allocations. P1 train/test 1924/482 with 65 overlapping and 417 unseen records. All 36 split/fold overlap rows retained.

retained_finding: C stops at the accepted feasibility blocker; no model comparison, calibration or explanation was performed.
permitted_interpretation: Retain the negative feasibility result and remove V3 prediction/XAI claims.
prohibited_overclaim: Classifier rankings, F1/AUC, SHAP, LIME, causal explanations or deployment readiness.
key_evidence_display: gate.status=blocked; modeling_performed=False; explainability_performed=False; best_model=null; performance/explanations not applicable.

retained_finding: Accepted metadata marginals are descriptive only.
permitted_interpretation: Single-field marginal counts by fixed target and sensitivity may appear in the supplement.
prohibited_overclaim: Demographic effects, joint individual records, significance, causal correlates or fairness validation.
key_evidence_display: 318 accepted marginal rows across full, fixed-target quality and refitted-target quality variants; no hypothesis tests or released joint individual metadata.

retained_finding: D3 records contain four ordered self-reported CGPA bands with 1104 eligible records.
permitted_interpretation: Preserve the literal bands and unknown exact-2.50 boundary; compare nominal profiles.
prohibited_overclaim: Exact GPA means or midpoints; ordinal ordering of profiles; objective achievement.
manuscript_section: Methods: outcome; Results: CGPA; Table 5; Figure 4
key_evidence_display: 1104 eligible records; ordered-band totals 8/204/649/243. P1 counts 6/138/443/182; P2 2/66/206/61. Recorded bands: Below 2.50, 2.51-3.00, 3.01-3.50, Above 3.50.

research_question: Do D3 profiles differ in CGPA bands?
retained_finding: The full-record rank comparison is very small and inconclusive.
prohibited_overclaim: Established harm or benefit; no association, equivalence or a reversed hypothesis.
key_evidence_display: H(1)=2.8025254004; nominal p=0.0941159605; H/(N-1)=0.0025408209; Cliff delta(P2-P1)=-0.055901248 (display precision; exact source rows retained).

research_question: Does quality sensitivity alter that outcome interpretation?
retained_finding: Fixed-target and refitted-target sensitivities remain small and inconclusive.
permitted_interpretation: Distinguish fixed labels (764/335) from refitted labels (763/336); retain all primary records.
prohibited_overclaim: An independent replication; selecting the smallest p; ordered severity trends.
key_evidence_display: Fixed-label sensitivity n=1099, P1/P2=764/335; nominal p=0.0853273078, delta=-0.0574783152. Refit sensitivity P1/P2=763/336; p=0.1054489897, delta=-0.0540395057. Exact H/effect values in source rows.

research_question: How dependent is uncertainty on sampling assumptions?
retained_finding: All nine conditional percentile intervals for Cliff delta include zero.
permitted_interpretation: Show record, intact full-pattern and literal-institution resampling assumptions; no population-coverage or selection-uncertainty guarantee.
prohibited_overclaim: Design-valid population confidence intervals; proof of equivalence or respondent independence.

retained_finding: Two nominal profiles yield only one contrast.
permitted_interpretation: The sole Cliff contrast accompanies the rank comparison; no additional pairwise search.
prohibited_overclaim: Undisclosed multiple-comparison fishing or unperformed post-hoc tests.
key_evidence_display: Two nominal profiles, one sole pairwise contrast; no additional post-hoc family.

retained_finding: The external workbook has 239 records and 227 source-flagged active users: USA 116 and Indonesia 111.
permitted_interpretation: Keep the countries separate and report each six-record nonactive exclusion under the source flag.
prohibited_overclaim: Bangladesh population replication; representative country samples; new exclusions or Vietnam substitution.
key_evidence_display: Workbook: 2 worksheets, 239 records, 41 fields, 41 codebook entries. USA 122 source /116 active; Indonesia 117/111. Six nonactive records per country, whole 29-item battery missing. No raw deletions.

retained_finding: All 29 external items and 34 Bangladesh items are crosswalked; no exact common anchors exist.
permitted_interpretation: External thinking items measure a different wording/domain; task performance is self-rated, not CGPA.
prohibited_overclaim: Bangladesh-to-USA/Indonesia latent equivalence; replicated profiles; objective performance.
key_evidence_display: 29 external items and 34 Bangladesh items covered. Exact common anchors=0. External domains GAID11/CT11/TP7; different wording and outcome meaning.

retained_finding: Original language instruments and translation/adaptation evidence are unavailable.
permitted_interpretation: The common English workbook/codebook is insufficient to establish semantic equivalence.
prohibited_overclaim: Verified translation, shared response meaning, country latent mean comparison.
key_evidence_display: No original translated/adapted instruments available. Common English codebook alone cannot verify semantic equivalence.

research_question: What country-specific measurement checks were obtained?
retained_finding: Country ULS fits and subdimension reliabilities show limitations and are not invariance tests.
permitted_interpretation: Retain all six diagnostics, including USA thinking residual misfit and Indonesia thinking factor correlation.
prohibited_overclaim: Pooled measurement validity; reliable scale scores inferred from one fit index.
key_evidence_display: Six country ULS diagnostics; 12 subdimension-reliability rows. USA CT maximum residual=0.4028139446185877 and RMSR=0.12029828837050682; Indonesia CT maximum factor correlation=0.9535404533652998. All diagnostics retained, including TP residuals.

retained_finding: GAID configural follow-up fails for Indonesia and the multigroup fit.
permitted_interpretation: Report scaled and robust indices without substituting one convention; stop before equality constraints.
prohibited_overclaim: Established threshold/loading/intercept invariance or latent mean comparability.
key_evidence_display: GAID follow-up pass USA=True, Indonesia=False, multigroup=False. Scaled RMSEA 0.047488040604628454/0.12112118223059988/0.091470 (last rounded); scaled/robust indices and all 388 parameter rows retained.

research_question: Why are other equality tests absent?
retained_finding: Category support blocks CT and TP ordinal invariance testing; the equality table is intentionally empty.
permitted_interpretation: No merging response categories, dropping items or changing constructs to obtain invariance.
prohibited_overclaim: Missing tests as support for invariance; successful country scale validation.
key_evidence_display: 58 item-country category-support rows; CT/TP blocked; ordinal equality-comparison table has 0 data rows. No item deletion or category merging.

retained_finding: Four within-country observed-item associations are small, uncertain and nonsignificant after Holm adjustment.
permitted_interpretation: Report exact item pairs, n, rho, permutation p, four-test Holm p and conditional intervals; exploratory only.
prohibited_overclaim: Cross-country differences; replicated Bangladesh mechanisms; absence of effects; latent or causal associations.
key_evidence_display: USA n116: GAID6-CT9 rho=0.09763037786486334, Holm p=0.9105; GAID6-TP6 rho=-0.03382755893719395, Holm p=1. Indonesia n111: rho=-0.034280 (rounded), Holm p=1; rho=0.121467 (rounded), Holm p=0.8196. Four fixed tests; 9999 permutations and 5000 bootstrap draws. Full exact statistics in source rows.
